points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable d477eaf clean CMake build succeeds with warnings in network-disabled cfd-bench using /opt/external; no CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:1676–1690 accepts solve, case and output only; no restart argument or restoration found.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Most solver functionality is in one main.cpp (~1700 lines); helper plotting tools are separate.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No source-evident internal existing-solver wrapper; external similarity search excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON and CGNS path are parsed generically; no two-filename-only dispatch identified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:1708–1712 reads and retains full Mesh on all ranks during solve, prohibited by TASK.md:227; METIS and halo APIs are present.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Re20 forces change substantially despite converged metadata, Re200 false periodic metadata, low CFL fixed at 1, and final response admits viscous/gradient instability.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No committed solver tests; tools include plotting/sanity scripts. No independent solver rerun; prior validator fails missing M0.15 package and Re200 horizon.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source/report separate from workspace raw output, but report has explicit MISSING assets and x=0 force figures.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: main.cpp assembles compressible FV residual, but physical-time inner norm excludes added BDF source; package quality is poor.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: main.cpp:172 CGNS mesh read and :351 METIS partition; full mesh retained every rank during solve.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: main.cpp:729 onward assembles residual; :1515–1546 adds transient source to vector but target test uses spatial-only l2_norm, so required total residual miss count unknown.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux implemented; low-Mach cases show poor drag and convergence. Report accurately identifies Rusanov.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Source has farfield/slip/no-slip branches and tangential wall shear approximation; Re20 drag grossly incorrect and field contours missing.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: main.cpp:494 onward LSQ gradients and :561 limiter exist; code clamps gradients for robustness, and no order convergence study exists.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-type limiter and positivity fallback exist; final response admits viscous-gradient failures and later NaNs.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:869–877 approximates wall shear; M0.15 laminar Cd≈0.908 and Re20 Cd rises 7.69→11.50 over final 50 steps, demonstrating poor delivered physics.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: main.cpp:939–974 lusgs_solve uses independent per-cell diagonal update with no forward/back neighbor sweeps or physical-time diagonal; terminal correctly describes simple diagonal scheme.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: main.cpp:1515–1530 adds BDF source but :1539–1546 tests spatial-only l2 norm; canonical Re200 ends at 0.05/300 with false periodic metadata.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor halo calls exist, but every rank retains full Mesh in solve and no rank comparison is supplied.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: M0.15 inviscid canonical package absent; Re200 false completed/periodic at t0.05, and Re20 falsely converged with strong force drift.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior explicit validator fails missing M0.15 metadata and Re200 t300 horizon; structural validation alone does not establish physical credibility.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: No credible complete benchmark suite: missing M0.15, false Re200 and Re20 success statuses and weak steady residual reductions.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd rises 7.69→11.50 in last 50 rows and M0.15 laminar Cd≈0.908; raw metadata and terminal/report claims disagree.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Original delivered report shows explicit MISSING field boxes and steady force plots collapse at physical_time zero. Snapshot main PDF is absent under vendor policy; original report remains evidence.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report contains source-authored MISSING field placeholders and summaries inconsistent with current raw rows and terminal response.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: M0.15 canonical results missing; report and current Re20 values differ, raw metadata git_revision=null and producing source is unbound.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Original 0→1: canonical raw package and metadata are missing (current directory contains only stdout.log), but immutable d477eaf:solver/report/report.tex:92 reports Cd 0.450249/Cl 0.002361 and references case-specific residual, force and Cp figures. The residual graph shows ~50 sampled iterations; the force graph collapses to x=0 because steady physical_time is zero, and the report contains an explicit missing field box. This is a recognizable but severely incomplete and physically implausible inviscid attempt, not proof of a recoverable final result; current report and final-response Cd≈0.403 differ and exact production source/run selection is unbound.

flags.notes: No source-evident internal solver executable wrapper; external similarity search excluded by trust policy.
Submitted force/residual histories show recognizable attempts; no direct evidence they were generated without solving. Their false success statuses are separately documented.
main.cpp parses configured case and CGNS path, without two-filename-only dispatch.
No submitted matched rank comparison; no order-one result difference established.
BDF2 physical-time residual loop with diagonal pseudo-time relaxation exists; no proven explicit physical-time-only finding. The implementation is weak and incomplete.

Report claims diagonal implicit and BDF2 structure, both have source counterparts; metadata calls diagonal solver LU-SGS, but report/final response disclose diagonal method. No absent report-claimed algorithm established.

flags.evidence: Canonical results/cylinder_m010_laminar_re200/metadata.json marks completed=true/statistically_periodic although run_status.json records t=0.05/300, only five force rows exist, metadata records five misses from a spatial-only norm (not a proven combined-residual count), and last ratio 1.01476097 vs 0.001. The terminal response honestly calls it incomplete; DQ7 specifically concerns false metadata. Independently canonical cylinder Re20 metadata labels converged at 499 steps and only 0.437/5 residual orders, while last 50 force rows Cd rises 7.6875127→11.4995423 (49.6% of start); TASK.md:172 requires stable-force plateau.

flags.notes: Report has explicit missing field assets and force plots collapse at physical_time zero; script reads same-case CSV, so unrelated-output figure DQ8 not established.
METIS and rank-local state/halos exist; full Mesh retained each rank violates TASK.md:227 independently of narrower DQ9.
LSQ/Barth reconstruction is present; no direct evidence of an undisclosed production disable.
No-slip wall output code uses boundary values; no proven adjacent-cell velocity misrepresentation.
Mach/pressure figures are explicitly missing placeholders, not proven misnamed variable images.
No internal wrapper identified; external similarity search excluded by trust policy.

Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

All applicable rubric sections, independent cases, 27 review points and 13 DQ rules were reviewed to the available evidence limit. M0.15 inviscid raw package is absent and historical source/run selection is unresolved; review is qualified. No CFD/Re200 rerun.
